name: tsoa-monorepo
description: Build swagger-compliant REST APIs using TypeScript and Node
author: Luke Autry <lukeautry@gmail.com> (http://www.lukeautry.com)

scripts.build: yarn workspace @tsoa/runtime build && yarn workspace @tsoa/cli build && yarn workspace tsoa build
scripts.check: yarn lint && yarn workspaces foreach -A --no-private run typecheck && yarn check:packages
scripts.clean: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude tsoa-monorepo run clean
scripts.test: yarn workspace tsoa-tests test && yarn workspace tsoa-tests-esm test
scripts.check:packages: publint packages/runtime --pack false && publint packages/cli --pack false && publint packages/tsoa --pack false
